description: Ollama with two models, one deliberately outside the 'library' namespace.
demo_beat: step 2 - expand Ollama, show the models
why: model >= 2 is still the whole point and is now protected twice over. The glob no longer names .ollama -- it is '/Users/%/.%/models/manifests/%/%/%/%' -- so this scenario is what proves a product-free glob still finds both models. The fourth % catches the hf.co model: hardcoding registry.ollama.ai/library returns 1 of 2 and looks perfectly healthy. port >= 1 no longer depends on 11434 being in an IN list.
